headline: VSU Shootout 💥😱 Multiple Suspects STILL GHOSTING 👻🚫
text: Chesterfield 5-0 🐷🚨 got the midnight call 📞🌙 after gunplay 💥🔫 outside VSU dorms 🏠😭 at 1:28 AM. Five bodies 🚑 took bullets 💊, one fighting for life 😵‍💫. Campus went full lockdown 🔒🚨 then popped that code green 🟢🔓 but cops still swarming like ants at a picnic 🐜🍔. No cuffs on wrists yet ❌⛓️ so shooters still ghosting 👻🏃‍♂️. One vic was a student 📚😔, another straight up MINOR 🧒💔, both got patched up and bounced 🏥🚪. Lieutenant Lamb 🐑🗣️ says they got video evidence 📹🔍 but zero suspects in custody 🔒❌. VSU is an HBCU 🖤📖 with 5K students 🎓 and dorms just opened Friday like a fresh can of worms 🐛🍺. Classes supposed to kick off Monday 📅 but now everybody shook 😰💦. Multiple shooters = multiple headaches 🤕🤕 for the boys in blue 👮‍♂️. Stay safe out here fam 🛡️🙏
